new_today_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires GDM Environmental, Colorado-Based Grease and Septic Services Specialist
new_today_news.summary: Wind River Environmental acquired GDM Environmental, a Colorado-based grease and septic services specialist, marking Wind River's first expansion into the western United States.

backfill_news.headline: Barrel Energy Raises $173K via 6% Convertible Note
backfill_news.summary: Barrel Energy (OTC: BRLL) entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with CFI Capital LLC, issuing a $200,000 6% Convertible Redeemable Note. Net cash proceeds to the company were $173,000. The company operates Happy Traps, a Portland, Maine grease-trap and FOG waste-to-energy business.

backfill_news.headline: [Date unverified] WEFTEC 2026 Technical Exhibition and Conference
backfill_news.summary: WEFTEC 2026 takes place September 26-30, 2026 in New Orleans, Louisiana, bringing water quality professionals together for technical education, exhibitions, networking and solutions focused on wastewater treatment and water environment innovation.
